name: board-keeper
summary: Keeps a card board honest against the to-do list with plain code: closes cards whose items are all closed, moves cards forward on work signals, flags the odd ones, with daily caps, a kill switch, a move log and undo.

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (board.json, items.json and board-keeper/ live in $HUBKIT_HOME/state)
env.BK_STATE_DIR: optional: log, move log, flags and kill switch folder
env.BK_LIVE_OWNERS: optional: file listing live worker names
env.BK_CAP: optional: to-done fixes per day, default 25
env.BK_MOVE_CAP: optional: moves of any kind per day, default 100
